name: Lauren Young Tire (Sutherlin)

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial facility with a building featuring a light-colored metal roof|A large paved parking lot surrounds the main structure|Extensive outdoor tire storage is located on one side of the property in organized rows|A smaller secondary building is present near the tire storage area|The facility has direct frontage on East Central Avenue.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main building facade with multiple service bays and garage openings facing the street|A paved customer parking area is located directly in front of the building|The site has clear road access and frontage along East Central Avenue, with open paved area around the structure.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side of the main building with service areas|Large quantities of tires are stored in organized rows across an outdoor lot on this side|A smaller secondary building is visible near the tire storage|Paved areas provide vehicle movment around the site.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back of the multi-section building with additional service and storage space|Outdoor tire storage and open paved areas extend across portions of the rear and side of the property|Driving is possible around the main structure.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the main building with multiple service bay openings|Paved parking surround this side of the structure|The property maintains open access and clear views of the building elevation from the street side.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from East Central Avenue into the large paved parking and driving areas surrounding the main building. The open layout provides good space for emergency vehicle staging in front and around the sides of the facility. Outdoor tire storage occupies a significant portion of one side of the property and may limit movement in that zone. The main building has multiple service bay openings. The facility is located in a commercial area with good road frontage and neighboring businesses.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the property, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the main building? Are there multiple points of entry into the building itself? Is vehicle access available through all areas of the tire storage zone? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the rear or storage areas of the facility?
